scenarios.name: Create and inspect a ceramic appearance

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: I choose Ceramic from the create-appearance menu
a selected document appearance named "Default Ceramic" is created
the Appearance Editor opens with a preview and an editable name
the Ceramic section shows Type, Color and Finish
Finish offers High Gloss / Glazed, Satin and Matte
Finish Bumps, Relief Pattern and Tint are separate optional sections
